abstract: Choriocarcinoma of the nonmolar placenta is presumptively a rare entity and is usually associated with widespread maternal metastases at the time of diagnosis. Nonmetastatic disease goes unrecognized and undiagnosed because placental carcinoma can be limited to a few villi, and grossly evident disease is often misinterpreted as a placental infarct. The optimal treatment for patients with choriocarcinoma of the placenta is not known but aggressive combination chemotherapy is suggested for patients with metastatic disease. Historically, the prognosis for both mother and infant has been poor.
abstract_ja: 非奇胎性胎盤の絨毛癌は推定上まれな疾患であり、通常は診断時にすでに広範な母体転移を伴っている。非転移性の胎盤癌は数個の絨毛に限局しうるため認識されず、肉眼的に明らかな病変は胎盤梗塞と誤認されやすい。胎盤絨毛癌に対する最適な治療法は不明であるが、転移性疾患の患者には積極的な併用化学療法が示唆される。従来、母体と児のいずれの予後も不良であった。
